title: AION 2 Beginner Guide: How to Play with Friends
description: AION 2 is free-to-play on Steam. Public access opened on October 5, 2026 at 13:00 UTC. Install the main game, App 3393110, and sign in with your playing account.
summary: Choose **NA West, NA East, Europe, South America or Asia** in the client. Match the region, faction and exact server with friends. Steam and the official PURPLE service share the same game servers.
quickAnswer: Install AION 2 through Steam, choose your region, faction and exact server, adjust your controls and follow the main story. Public access is free-to-play.

workflow.title: Turn a first session into one clear next objective
workflow.caption: Use your current client to decide the next action. A level, a gear requirement and an Ascension objective are different checks.

steps.label: Prepare the account and group
steps.description: Finish the official client update and agree on region, faction, server and combat role.

steps.label: Follow the campaign
steps.description: Complete the current main-story objective and read the next journal entry.

steps.label: Identify the actual blocker
steps.description: Write down whether the gate is character level, a quest, Ascension or an equipment requirement.

steps.label: Solve that requirement
steps.description: Choose nearby accepted content or a targeted skill/equipment improvement instead of unrelated grinding.

steps.label: Save the next action
steps.description: Before stopping, record the quest destination or requirement and check bag space for the next session.

items.label: Install and update the official client
Agree on region, faction and exact server with friends
Choose a class for the role you want to play
Create the intended character on that server
Check movement, camera, combat and loot settings
Read the specific requirement when progress stops
Record one next action and check inventory space
